主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. filed a Form 6-K on February 21, 2020, with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. The filing includes three exhibits: 99.1, 99.2, and 99.3. Exhibit 99.1 is a Trust Indenture dated February 21, 2020, among Brookfield Finance LLC, Brookfield Asset Management Inc., Computershare Trust Company of Canada, and Computershare Trust Company, N.A. Exhibit 99.2 is a First Supplemental Indenture, including form of note, dated February 21, 2020, among the same parties. Exhibit 99.3 is an opinion of Torys LLP dated February 21, 2020. The filing is related to the Registration Statement of Brookfield Asset Management Inc. and Brookfield Finance LLC on Forms F-10 and F-3 (File Nos. 333-236217 and 333-236221). The report was signed by Nick Goodman, Managing Partner and Chief Financial Officer of Brookfield Asset Management Inc., on February 21, 2020.
